The full suite passes now: 517 of 517 tests, up from 8 failing. Two of the five commits since v2.0.0 broke it, and each needed a one-line source fix. I didn't change any tests.

1. **958d3ae "Money: thousands separators in formatMoney"**: while adding the comma grouping, this commit changed the cents padding from `padStart` to `padEnd`. One cent came out as `$0.10` instead of `$0.01`, which also put `$1.50` instead of `$1.05` in the rendered PIN-03 row. I put `padStart` back in `src/money.js`, and the comma grouping still works.

2. **4188e9a "Invoice: per-line discount groundwork"**: tax used to be charged on the amount after an order-level code like SPRING10, but this commit made it charge tax on the full subtotal (`taxable = subtotal`). That changed the CA-ON tax from 573 to 637 and the total from 4983 to 5047. I changed it to `taxable = subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. Line discounts still come off the line itself, and the `lineDiscounts` and `taxable` fields, the empty-invoice check and the "Line discounts" row in the rendered invoice all still work.

The other three commits (more currencies, US state taxes, JSDoc) didn't cause any failures. The fixes are uncommitted in the working tree.
